test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which team lost in the final match of the Hero Indian Super League, 2020-2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ATK Mohun Bagan FC.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mumbai City FC won the final match of the Hero Indian Super League, 2020-2021 while ATK Mohun Bagan FC lost the match.**
 
• The league Winners Shield was won by **Mumbai City FC.**
 
• The semi-finalists were **North East United FC **
